title: Consultation Response Tracker
description: Open/closed roll-up over a caller-declared set of regulatory consultations against a declared as-of date: open count, closed-unresponded count, the ids of missed closes, whole days to the next unresponded close, and an overall verdict (ATTENTION_REQUIRED / ON_TRACK / ALL_RESPONDED). Declared-date discipline: as_of is your declared date, never a clock; it does not read any register, portal, feed, or calendar, and responded is your declaration, never a check. Absent or invalid inputs fail closed and are named. No network, no storage, no clock.

as_of.description: Declared as-of calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Never a runtime clock.

closes.description: Declared close date, YYYY-MM-DD. A close equal to as_of is still open.

responded.description: Caller-declared response status; the tool never verifies against a register.

open.description: Count of consultations whose closes date is on or after as_of; null on the fail-closed path.

closed_unresponded.description: Count of consultations that closed before as_of with responded=false.

missed.description: Ids of closed-unresponded consultations, in declared order.

days_to_next_close.description: Whole days from as_of to the earliest close among open unresponded consultations; null when none remains.

overall.description: ATTENTION_REQUIRED iff a missed close exists; else ON_TRACK iff an open unresponded consultation exists; else ALL_RESPONDED.

trace.description: Human-readable derivation, or fail-closed reasons naming each rejected input.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_consultation_response_tracker
mcp_tool_definition.description: Rolls up a caller-declared consultation list against a declared as-of date: open count, closed-unresponded count, missed ids, whole days to the next unresponded close, and an overall ATTENTION_REQUIRED/ON_TRACK/ALL_RESPONDED verdict. Declared dates only, never a clock; reads no register, portal, feed, or calendar. Invalid inputs fail closed and are named.
